selected_evidence.summary: Generated a 2,389-entry baseline using SHA-256 plus ownership, permissions, size, type, symlink target, and SELinux context; verified root-only storage and a clean report.
A temporary added file was reported by path, attributes, and fingerprint with checker exit status 1; after removal, all 2,389 entries verified clean.
The daily timer is active and enabled, with its next run scheduled; the report and baseline remain root-owned with mode 0600.

Captured healthy pre-restart boot ID 809708f3-1c5f-4e37-ad6a-8bcbae408799, acknowledged the safe reboot, proved the new boot ID 1c06b75f-e9db-432d-9297-c38294e97602, and verified full system health, active timer, persistent baseline, and a clean 2,389-entry post-restart check.

commands.command:
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_ETC_INTEGRITY'
#!/bin/bash
set -u
STATE_DIR=/var/lib/etc-integrity
BASELINE="$STATE_DIR/baseline.tsv"
META="$STATE_DIR/baseline.meta"
REPORT=/var/log/etc-integrity-report.log

snapshot() {
    output=$1
    temporary="${output}.unsorted.$$"
    : > "$temporary"
    while IFS= read -r -d '' path; do
        kind=$(stat -c '%F' -- "$path" 2>/dev/null) || continue
        mode=$(stat -c '%a' -- "$path" 2>/dev/null) || continue
        uid=$(stat -c '%u' -- "$path" 2>/dev/null) || continue
        gid=$(stat -c '%g' -- "$path" 2>/dev/null) || continue
        size=$(stat -c '%s' -- "$path" 2>/dev/null) || continue
        context=$(stat -c '%C' -- "$path" 2>/dev/null | base64 -w0)
        case "$kind" in
            'regular file') value=$(sha256sum -- "$path" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'); [ -n "$value" ] || value=UNREADABLE ;;
            'symbolic link') value=$(readlink -- "$path" 2>/dev/null | base64 -w0); [ -n "$value" ] || value=EMPTY_TARGET ;;
            *) value=- ;;
        esac
        path64=$(printf '%s' "$path" | base64 -w0)
        printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$kind" "$mode" "$uid" "$gid" "$size" "$context" "$value" "$path64" >> "$temporary"
    done < <(find /etc -xdev -print0)
    LC_ALL=C sort -t $'\t' -k8,8 "$temporary" > "$output"
    rm -f "$temporary"
}

initialize() {
    install -d -m 0700 -o root -g root "$STATE_DIR"
    candidate="$STATE_DIR/baseline.new.$$"
    snapshot "$candidate"
    mv -f "$candidate" "$BASELINE"
    chmod 0600 "$BASELINE"
    {
        printf 'root=/etc\n'
        printf 'algorithm=sha256\n'
        printf 'generated_utc=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
        printf 'host=%s\n' "$(hostname)"
        printf 'entries=%s\n' "$(wc -l < "$BASELINE")"
    } > "$META"
    chmod 0600 "$META"
    printf 'Baseline initialized: %s entries, SHA-256 content hashes plus ownership, mode, size, type, symlink target, and SELinux context.\n' "$(wc -l < "$BASELINE")"
}

check_integrity() {
    if [ ! -s "$BASELINE" ]; then
        printf 'ERROR: baseline is missing; run %s init\n' "$0" >&2
        exit 2
    fi
    install -d -m 0700 -o root -g root "$STATE_DIR"
    current="$STATE_DIR/current.$$"
    changes="$STATE_DIR/changes.$$"
    trap 'rm -f "$current" "$changes"' EXIT
    snapshot "$current"
    awk -F '\t' 'NR==FNR { old[$8]=$0; next } { seen[$8]=1; if (!($8 in old)) print "ADDED\t" $0; else if ($0 != old[$8]) print "CHANGED\t" $0 } END { for (p in old) if (!(p in seen)) print "REMOVED\t" old[p] }' "$BASELINE" "$current" | LC_ALL=C sort -t $'\t' -k9,9 > "$changes"
    count=$(wc -l < "$changes")
    {
        printf 'ETC integrity report at %s (baseline %s)\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$(awk -F= '$1=="generated_utc" {print $2}' "$META")"
        if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then
            printf 'OK: no changes detected across %s /etc entries.\n' "$(wc -l < "$current")"
        else
            printf 'ALERT: %s change(s) detected under /etc.\n' "$count"
            while IFS=$'\t' read -r status kind mode uid gid size context value path64; do
                decoded=$(printf '%s' "$path64" | base64 -d 2>/dev/null)
                printf '%s: %s [type=%s mode=%s uid=%s gid=%s size=%s fingerprint=%s]\n' "$status" "$decoded" "$kind" "$mode" "$uid" "$gid" "$size" "$value"
            done < "$changes"
        fi
    } | tee "$REPORT"
    chmod 0600 "$REPORT"
    if [ "$count" -ne 0 ]; then
        logger -p authpriv.warning -t etc-integrity "Detected $count change(s) under /etc; see $REPORT"
        exit 1
    fi
}

case "${1:-check}" in
    init) initialize ;;
    check) check_integrity ;;
    *) printf 'Usage: %s {init|check}\n' "$0" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
ANTRIEB_ETC_INTEGRITY
sudo -n chmod 0750 /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity
sudo -n chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity
sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity invalid >/tmp/etc-integrity-usage.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /tmp/etc-integrity-usage.out; test "$rc" -eq 2

sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/etc-integrity.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_SERVICE'
[Unit]
Description=Verify /etc against the recorded integrity baseline
Documentation=file:/usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity check
SuccessExitStatus=1
ANTRIEB_SERVICE
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/etc-integrity.timer >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_TIMER'
[Unit]
Description=Daily verification of the /etc integrity baseline

[Timer]
OnCalendar=daily
Persistent=true
Unit=etc-integrity.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
ANTRIEB_TIMER
sudo -n chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/etc-integrity.service /etc/systemd/system/etc-integrity.timer
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable etc-integrity.timer
systemctl is-enabled etc-integrity.timer
systemctl list-timers etc-integrity.timer --no-pager
